image_description: A close-up view of an ornate, dark metal breastplate (part of a suit of armor). The surface is polished but shows signs of age or patina, with intricate embossed floral or scrollwork designs etched into the upper chest area. The plate features a raised central ridge and curved edges conforming to a torso shape. Visible attachment points include leather straps with brass rivets on the left shoulder and a row of decorative studs along the bottom edge.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific type of armor and distinguish it from other metallic objects or costumes.
To analyze the realism of the metal reflections, etching depth, and potential AI-generated texture smearing.
To ensure the straps connect logically to the plate and the plate edges are structurally sound without melting.
To verify that the etched designs have consistent depth and do not appear flat or warped onto the curved surface.

focus_areas: Consistency of light reflection on curved metal surfaces
Logical connection of leather straps to metal rivets
Depth and clarity of embossed ornamental patterns
Structural integrity of the central ridge
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the interaction between the embossed patterns and the underlying curvature of the plate. AI often fails to warp 2D textures correctly over 3D curves. Also, inspect the rivets on the leather straps for geometric consistency (circular shape vs. oval distortion) based on perspective.
